analysis: The code snippet contains multiple calls to `Arrays.asList` within the `else` branch: `Arrays.asList(includes)`, `Arrays.asList(selectRule.mandatoryDims)`, and inside loops `Arrays.asList(ss)` where `ss` is each element of `selectRule.hierarchyDims` and `selectRule.jointDims`. According to the API documentation, `Arrays.asList` throws `NullPointerException` if the specified array is `null`. The snippet performs no null checks on `includes`, `selectRule.mandatoryDims`, or the elements of `selectRule.hierarchyDims` and `selectRule.jointDims` before passing them to `asList`. Therefore, if any of these arrays are `null`, a `NullPointerException` will be thrown. The documentation also mentions `ArrayStoreException` for list operations, but that is not thrown by the `asList` call itself. Hence, only `NullPointerException` is relevant and its throwing condition is not avoided in the snippet.
answer: The only declared exception of `Arrays.asList` is `NullPointerException`. Its throwing condition (array argument is null) is not avoided for any of the calls in the snippet because there are no null checks before invoking `asList`.
remark: `NullPointerException` can be triggered if any of the following arrays are `null`: `includes`, `selectRule.mandatoryDims`, an element `ss` of `selectRule.hierarchyDims` (i.e., if the array contains a null element), or an element `ss` of `selectRule.jointDims`. Additionally, if `selectRule.hierarchyDims` or `selectRule.jointDims` itself is `null`, the for-each loop will throw a `NullPointerException` before even calling `asList`, but that is not from the API call itself.
